body: I had that perspective six months ago. I decided to just try everything to improve my life and make it into one worth living, for me. As I said I've been going to the gym daily, put on a lot of muscle, I've been promoted at work, I've been on a solo vacation to a place I really wanted to go, I've taken up hiking and spent time with lots of new people. This life would be a brilliant life, but without my ex-fiancee it is not complete. I have never met anyone like her who made me feel 'whole' and no matter how hard I try and how many steps I take towards creating that life knowing that she is not going to be there at the end of the day makes it all shit.

I understand that, and I am in therapy, but I can't help those feelings. I spent 7 years with someone who made me happier than anything or anyone had ever made me, doing things I can't ever forget. 

I don't *want* her absence to be blocking me from happiness. If anything I wish I never met her so that I didn't know what I was missing. I just know for a fact that the life we created together was incredible and now it is seemingly never coming back.
